title: Booking Limits and Deposit Figures Recorded Against Each Vacation Package Product
content:
Every one of Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products carries its own booking limits and its own deposit figures. The figures below are read against the product the package was quoted under, and against no other product in the range.

## Advance purchase, booking window and party size

| Product | Departure at least this many calendar days ahead | Departure no more than this many calendar days ahead | Smallest party | Largest party on one package | Party size from which the group desk takes the booking |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | 7 | 365 | 1 | 6 | 7 |
| Flex Bundle Package | 3 | 365 | 1 | 8 | 9 |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | 14 | 400 | 2 | 8 | 9 |
| Escorted Tour Package | 30 | 450 | 1 | 12 | 13 |
| Ocean Cruise Package | 45 | 540 | 2 | 10 | 11 |
| Luxury Collection Package | 21 | 540 | 2 | 8 | 9 |

## Deposit and agency service fee

| Product | Deposit per traveller | Deposit as a share of the package price | Reduced promotional deposit per traveller | Agency service fee per traveller |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | 150.00 USD | 0 per cent | permitted, at 49.00 USD | 29.95 USD |
| Flex Bundle Package | 200.00 USD | 0 per cent | permitted, at 79.00 USD | 24.95 USD |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | 300.00 USD | 15 per cent | permitted, at 99.00 USD | 19.95 USD |
| Escorted Tour Package | 400.00 USD | 20 per cent | not permitted, recorded as 0.00 USD | 24.95 USD |
| Ocean Cruise Package | 500.00 USD | 25 per cent | not permitted, recorded as 0.00 USD | 34.95 USD |
| Luxury Collection Package | 1000.00 USD | 30 per cent | not permitted, recorded as 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |

## Conditions of entry recorded against each product

| Product | Board basis | Further condition of entry |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | room only | not escorted |
| Flex Bundle Package | room only | not escorted |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | all inclusive | not escorted |
| Escorted Tour Package | full board | escorted throughout by a tour manager |
| Ocean Cruise Package | full board | sold as a sailing |
| Luxury Collection Package | all inclusive | by invitation only |

## Worked on hypothetical particulars

A party of four quoted under the All-Inclusive Resort Package reads a deposit figure of 300.00 USD for each traveller, being 1,200.00 USD for the party, and an agency service fee figure of 19.95 USD for each traveller, being 79.80 USD for the party. A figure of 0.00 USD in the reduced promotional deposit column records that the product carries no such deposit at all.
